n: Utah AI, Media, Safety, and I: A Deep Dive health lesson
t: A 75 to 90 minute health lesson on technology, screen time, and safe AI use.
steps: Download the PowerPoint as a .pptx file and the worksheet.
Print the worksheets and prepare sticky notes and paper.
Choose a school approved AI image generator.
Ask IT to confirm the generator is allowed for students.
Set up a Google Form for image uploads.
Preview the Utah website the students will research.
